name: The Pool Level
body: Reached by the waterproof staircase in the shaft. Underground but never dark — underwater LEDs, ambient strip lighting, water-glow off tiled walls. A full-length lap pool with lane lines for Umiko's coaching, deep enough to dive at one end, its lighting cycling cool blue for morning laps and warm gold for evening swims, plus a violet setting Mercedes programmed for mood that nobody has changed because it works. A sunken hot tub beside it seats eight comfortably or fourteen if motivated. Two changing rooms with heated floors and mirrors that fog dramatically, which the girls treat as a feature.
